coolhunting.title: The Office
coolhunting.notes: Adds three Dispatch pieces (MIT's Met Warehouse reuse by Diller Scofidio + Renfro, Sauerbruch Hutton and Studio Gang's German House retrofit in New York, and NUA Arquitectures' timber office inside a Catalan textile warehouse). No dispatch retired yet — the oldest (Stirling shortlist, 16 July) is not past the six-week mark. Confirms organiser dates for Cersaie, Design Miami, Maison&Objet, Stockholm Furniture Fair's 2027 relaunch, Salone del Mobile 2027 (including the new OMA-masterplanned Salone Contract platform), the Venice Architecture Biennale 2027 (curators and theme), Clerkenwell Design Week, 3daysofdesign and NeoCon. Adds the AJ Retrofit & Reuse Awards ceremony (24 September) to the calendar.
